name: Spherical shallow water equations dataset
model_or_instrument: Spherical SWE spectral solver (Galewsky barotropically unstable jet setup)
size_as_stated: 2048 trajectories of SWE on a rotating sphere, keeping the last T = 32 of vorticity snapshots
access: Synthetic data is generated according to the script provided in https://github.com/juannat7/cohesion.

scales.note: Global spherical shallow water equation runs on Earth radius; 12-day integration saved every 5 hours on 120x240 grid
